**Student levels and organizations covered by the conduct policy:**

- All NYU students, including those acting in official and unofficial capacities, are covered by the policy.
- Student organizations are also covered, and both individual members and organizations may be held accountable for violations of the policy [1][2].

**Schools and locations covered by the conduct policy:**

- The policy applies broadly across NYU, including all university schools and locations, such as the Center for Student Life and all university clubs, school-based clubs, etc. Nothing precludes NYU from addressing misconduct within any part of the university community [4].

**Additional notes:**

- Alleged violations by individual students are resolved under NYU Student Conduct Procedures [3].
- The policy is applicable across the entire university, encompassing all schools and campus locations, although specific details on geographic coverage are not explicitly listed in the sources provided.

**Summary:**
The conduct policy covers all NYU students (at all levels) and student organizations (including clubs and university-based groups). It applies across all NYU schools and locations, including the Center for Student Life and other campus-based entities [1][2][4].
